# eHealth Collaborates with a Top 3 Medicare Carrier to Support Medicare Advantage Plan Selection and Enrollment for the Upcoming Annual Enrollment Period


September 24, 2026


**INDIANAPOLIS , Sept. 24, 2026** –[eHealth](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4781676-1&h=847168175&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ehealthinsurance.com%2F&a=eHealth) (Nasdaq: EHTH), a leading private online health insurance marketplace, today announced a new collaboration with a top three Medicare carrier to provide additional call center capacity through its Amplify model, helping Medicare Advantage shoppers ahead of and during the upcoming Annual Enrollment Period.


"The new agreement illustrates our joint commitment to customer care and assisting Medicare beneficiaries with the insights they need to make the right coverage decisions for their needs," said Derrick Duke, CEO of eHealth. "With a record number of Medicare beneficiaries expected to make coverage decision during this fall's Annual Enrollment Period, the collaboration will help ensure the consumers our carrier partner serves receive the outstanding service it is known for."


The collaboration is being delivered through eHealth's Amplify model, which provides carrier-dedicated enrollment, service, and call center support solutions to health plans. The agreement deepens eHealth's relationship with one of the nation's largest health plans, while enabling eHealth to diversify the services it offers beyond the company's traditional health insurance advisory business.


**About eHealth**
For nearly 30 years, eHealth, Inc. (Nasdaq: EHTH) has helped millions of Americans find the healthcare coverage that fits their needs at a price they can afford, using data, artificial intelligence and a consumer-first approach to help people quickly and effectively compare insurance options. As a leading independent licensed insurance agency and advisor, eHealth offers access to plans from more than 180 health insurers, including national and regional companies, supporting consumers during their working years and retirement. eHealth's licensed insurance agents help match consumers with the insurance plans, services, and support they need to live healthier, more financially secure lives.
